entries.summary: <h2>Moon Alert</h2> <p>There are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Libra.</p><h2>Aries (March 21-April 19)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today the moon is opposite your sign, which means you have to go more than halfway when dealing with others. In other words, be accommodating and cooperative. (It's not a big deal.) Having said that, a partner or close friend might be critical or difficult today. ("What? After all my goodwill?")</p><h2>Taurus (April 20-May 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> The good news is that you have the determination to be productive today. In fact, everything you do will be more powerful and more intense. Late in the day, don't let criticism or comments from someone older discourage you. What do they know?</p><h2>Gemini (May 21-June 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Parents need to take a lighter touch dealing with their kids today because you might be obsessed about something — or perhaps they are? Furthermore, it's easy to feel critical, which will discourage them. Remember the advice of Johann Goethe: "Correction does much; but encouragement does more."</p><h2>Cancer (June 21-July 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Family discussions will be emotional today, perhaps because someone — and this someone could be you — is obsessed about something. This will make you exhausted. Later in the day, difficulties with parents and authority figures might also discourage you. (Send out for dark chocolate.)</p><h2>Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today has its challenges because discussions with others might not be easy. In fact, you might feel isolated or cut off — certainly misunderstood or ignored. Be careful that you are not caught up in a one-track thinking mode because it's easy to do this today. Don't be discouraged by others — or the news.</p><h2>Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today, money issues and finances might be important to you. Discussions about taxes, debt, credit, inheritances or shared property might absorb your thinking, which is why you might overwhelm someone else who is less interested. Take a deep breath and reorient yourself.</p><h2>Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today the moon is in your sign dancing with Pluto, which can intensify your emotions and make you obsessed with something. Or you might feel compelled to discuss something or act on certain feelings. Meanwhile, partners and close friends lack sympathy. (Hang in there.)</p><h2>Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today has its challenges. Accept this right off the bat and decide to move forward carefully item by item, step by step. Don't expect fast results. Do what is right in front of you on your plate. Reduce your expectations of yourself and others. Be proud of what you achieve.</p><h2>Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> You might attract someone to you today who seems to be like a zealot. They're so gung-ho about their ideas — they won't let go. (Possibly you are this person?) Meanwhile, relations with your kids and romantic partners might be stilted and strained. Channel your energy into work.</p><h2>Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> You're noticed today. You might be keen about an idea, yet you feel no one is listening. (There are none so deaf as those who are wearing headphones.) Be patient with family members. It's easy to feel disappointed with someone today.</p><h2>Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> You want to save the world before bedtime. Perhaps today you're on your soapbox urging others to listen to your ideas because you feel it's important to be heard. You might be right, but if you're obsessed with something, people will turn away. (You know this.)</p><h2>Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-290000" name="html-embed-module-290000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>so-so</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Financial discussions might be discouraging today. You might feel broke and no matter what happens, the light at the end of the tunnel looks like a train. Be reassured that this is a temporary dark cloud on your horizon. Courage!</p><h2>If today is your birthday</h2><p>Actress Meryl Streep (1949) shares your birthday today. You seek an enduring, romantic partnership — a perfect lifestyle. Finding true love is of paramount importance. This is a slower-paced year. Take time to rejuvenate your energy and outlook. Focus on business and personal relationships, and be with people who have your back. Be kind and helpful this year.</p>

entries.title: Brookfield Zoo is helping repopulate Bad Bunny concho
entries.summary: <p>Months after Super Bowl LX, Puerto Rico’s only native toad species is still having a moment thanks to Bad Bunny.</p><p>And with a little help from the Brookfield Zoo, that turn in the spotlight might just save the amphibian from extinction. </p><p>The singer’s mascot is named Concho, and it was created in the likeness of the endangered Puerto Rican crested toad. Bad Bunny, whose given name is Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, adopted the creature as a mascot and symbol of resilience, mirroring the toad’s struggles to stay alive with the displacement that islanders face today.</p><p>Known as the sapo concho in Spanish, the species is the Caribbean island’s only native toad. Years ago, the Puerto Rican Crested Toad Conservancy tapped the suburban Chicago zoo to breed thousands of tadpoles, but Brookfield hit a milestone this spring.</p><div class="Enhancement" species. The natural habitats of the toads have been lost due to the rise of invasive species, predators, gentrification and deforestation, according to expert biologist Ramón L. Rivera Lebrón, who works with Puerto Rico’s Department of Natural and Environmental Resources.</p><p>The sapo concho plays a crucial role in maintaining the island’s natural ecosystem. In protecting the toad’s habitats, ecologists are helping maintain the survival of other native Puerto Rican birds, reptiles and other wild animals. The amphibians also help keep insect populations at bay.</p><p>Rivera Lebrón describes the toads as “gorgeous” and “very elegant” creatures. They’re “much prettier” than the invasive marine toads that have contributed to the concho’s demise, he said.</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop=""> The number of tadpoles bred this year at Brookfield is the largest yield since the Chicagoland zoo first started breeding them in 2017.</p><p>“The best thing about conservation is when it has an end date,” said Mike Masellis, Brookfield Zoo’s lead animal care expert. He said the Puerto Rican Crested Toad Conservancy’s goal is to delist the species from endangered status within the next 10 years.</p><p>Masellis recently got his tires rotated and said that he spotted people in the waiting room wearing their own sapo concho t-shirts, signaling an increase in familiarity with the species. “Five years ago, that wasn't really the case,” he said.</p><p>“I think every celebrity should probably be paired with an endangered species because it helps a lot,” Masellis continued, noting that he’d love to host Bad Bunny at the zoo sometime. (The last time Bad Bunny performed in Chicago was <a class="Link" There, Masellis met with Rivera Lebrón and Jan Paul Zegarra, a biologist with the Fish and Wildlife Service who is also helping with the repopulation project.</p><p>“We released baby toads and some adult toads, and then we monitored and tracked them every night to see how they did after release,” he said. They observed the non-native marine toad — a South American species <a class="Link" href="https://amphibiaweb.org/cgi/amphib_query?where-genus=Rhinella&where-species=marina&account=lannoo" target="_blank" ><u>introduced to the island in 1919</u></a> to control agricultural pests — preying on sapo concho tadpoles and adult frogs.</p><p>Masellis said that the experts are “really looking for places where the tadpoles will have as little competition as possible.”</p><p>But everything starts in a small, humid room at the Brookfield Zoo. Set to 80 degrees Fahrenheit, the room is equipped with holding tanks for the toads, large sinks for the females to lay their eggs and live crickets for feeding time.An important piece of the puzzle for the zoo, Masellis said, is controlling the temperature of the conservation room.</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop=""> <figure Each package contains a styrofoam box with approximately 1,000 baby toads, kept alive with a heat pack and oxygen.</p><p>By the time they reach Puerto Rico’s tropical climate, the tadpoles are ready to be released in vernal pools in two specific parts of the island: Arecibo, on the northern coast, and Guánica, on the southern coast.</p><p>In Arecibo, the Toad Conservancy has big plans to build a large breeding facility. The building is still in the planning and permitting stages, Rivera Lebrón said. But it’ll be the central location of the project, and it will help cut down on shipping costs.</p><p>“Since the 90s, we haven't seen the toads in the wild in Arecibo,” Rivera Lebrón said. “They depended on cavities in certain streams that would flood sporadically during the rainy season. That stopped happening, and those genetics were eliminated.”</p><p>Tadpoles are released in the dry forests of the southern Guánica, Puerto Rico, where the last naturally occurring population of the crested toads lives today. That land is protected in the Guánica State Forest, River Lebrón said.</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop=""> <figure class="Figure"><a threat.</p><p>“Climate change has caused sea levels to rise and salinity to infiltrate the ponds, which used to be freshwater,” he said. “What were previously known as appropriate natural areas for the toads are still used, but the time they have to develop is much shorter.”</p><p>The biologist says that Bad Bunny’s music has helped increase media and research interest in the toads, but there is still a great need for resources.</p><p>The mascot even appeared on a float at Sunday’s <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/chicago/2026/06/13/chicago-puerto-rican-peoples-day-parade-division-street-rebellion" target="_blank" ><u>Puerto Rican People’s Day Parade</u></a>, rolling down Division Street sporting Concho’s signature blue long-sleeve and red sweatpants.</p><p>It’s those types of interactions with the mascot that Rivera Lebrón and his colleagues inspire even more interest in the real toads.</p><p>“It’s a unique species that has been featured by an artist, allowing people to take a closer look at Puerto Rico — and not just for conservation purposes,” he said. “Above all, I want people to learn about our culture and to get to know our one-of-a-kind animals.”<br></p>
